## About
Automotive Electronic Specialists, or AES, is a car audio and electronics shop on Southwest Fwy in Houston. We specialize in car audio, sales, service, and repair, and we troubleshoot all electrical problems.
Our technicians work on any and all types of vehicles: import, domestic, or exotic, with original equipment and aftermarket parts. We carry brands like KICKER, JL AUDIO, ALPINE, KENWOOD and PIONEER.
Neighbors rate us 4.8 from 22 reviews on Google, and one reviewer summed it up as old school customer service. If you have a question or need a quote, give us a call.

## Services
- Car audio sales, service, and repair: Stereos, amplifiers, speakers and woofers, sold, installed and repaired.
- iPod integration: Connect your device to your car's sound system.
- Navigation: Navigation systems installed in your vehicle.
- Security: Security systems to help protect your vehicle.
- Remote start systems: Start your car before you get to it.
- Factory BOSE-INFINITY-HARMON KARDON-MARK LEVINSON repair: Repair for factory premium sound systems.
- Electrical troubleshooting: We track down electrical problems of all kinds.

## FAQ
Q: Do you come to me?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we will come to you, usually within 24 to 48 hours.

Q: Can I book by text?
A: One customer said Mario accepts appointments via text and is quick to respond.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us at (713) 392-1228 with any questions or for a quote on a product or service.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
